clips.title: The story
paras: In the Wetlands, Rethiel the Greenwarden calls travelers to the Green Belt. He seeks help against threats that disturb the marsh's uneasy balance.

Rethiel asks sympathetic travelers to ease the Wetlands' suffering. He urges them to hunt the destructive Mosshide gnolls that ravage wildlife and take the crude flints they use to burn the marsh's living trees. He also calls for the diseased fen creepers festering in the marsh waters to be thinned. Rethiel hopes these efforts will bring peace back to the wounded soil.
